claims.claim_text: The two Albert J. Benedetto index rows and the official Army-entry record refer to the same person.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Both adjacent index rows share the exact name and private identifier; the official Army record repeats both and identifies him as a private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The unique private identifier is decisive. The repeated full name and Army private grade independently support retaining two source rows linked to one person entity.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to December 11, 1942; it does not explain why the index lists both Boxes 48 and 49 or establish the route into OSS.
claims.match_notes: Both printed index rows remain immutable and visible. The identifier is retained privately and masked publicly. Civilian occupation code 417 is not decoded because the inspected code-list text was ambiguous.

claims.claim_text: The official Army-entry record filed as Malvin D. Bendon is confirmed as Melvin D. Bendon in the OSS personnel index.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official files share the exact private identifier, surname, middle initial, and compatible enlisted status; only one vowel in the first name differs.
claims.identity_match_assessment: A unique private identifier is decisive. The surname, middle initial, and enlisted grades corroborate the match; Malvin is preserved as a documented variant, not silently corrected.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to March 2, 1943; it does not establish the date or route into OSS.
claims.match_notes: The identifier is retained privately and masked publicly.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry on March 2, 1943, Melvin D. Bendon was classified as a repairman or mechanic not elsewhere classified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-private-identifier Army record carries code 583, which NARA's corrected list defines as repairmen and mechanics not elsewhere classified.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier confirms that the Malvin-spelled Army record belongs to the indexed Melvin D. Bendon.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry, but not proven to identify the immediate pre-OSS role or a named civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: No company, workplace, exact trade, or self-employment status is inferred.

claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to February 25, 1942; it does not establish the date or route into OSS.
